[h1][b]一眼DOOM幸存者[/b][/h1] [h1]前言[/h1] 在类幸存者游戏井喷的如今，好像还没有一款第一人称的3D幸存者。 《Vampire Hunters》便勇敢的迈出了这一步，第一视角下看着数把武器共同开火，有着前所未有的紧张感和刺激感。 [h1]3D视角下的类幸存者[/h1] 其实严格意义上来说，本作并不属于第一个吃螃蟹的，COD的僵尸模式便有着和如今类幸存者极其相似的特征。 但本作将《吸血鬼幸存者》的自动射击、《土豆兄弟》的多武器作战、FPS游戏的换弹、跳跃等要素融合在一起后，带来的是一场新鲜独特的屠戮之旅。 [h1]双重游玩模式[/h1] 游戏共有两个模式：常规模式和幸存者模式。 常规模式下角色将在一条无尽的长廊中不断前进，手动开火击败各式敌人获取资源来购买武器和装备，以取得更好的成绩。 幸存者模式下角色身处一个血红色的地狱之中，恶魔敌人将从四面八方不断涌来，玩家需要击败敌人拾取经验值才能升级，升级时可以从系统给出的道具库中任选一个，和类幸存者的机制一样，这个操作不再需要花费额外资源。 [h1]生存与杀戮并重[/h1] 随着不断构筑，角色同时掌控的武器和装备会越来越多，活脱脱一个杀戮机器，不过众多的武器同时展现于眼前，一定程度上也遮挡了画面。 虽然射击是自动的，但是玩家可以选择手动装弹，以避免关键时候陷入没有子弹的尴尬局面。 游玩的过程和COD僵尸模式还是有点类似的，当年溜僵尸的操作也可以继续沿用。 [h1]结语[/h1] 得益于清脆的手感、丰富的武器、类幸存者模式的助力，《Vampire Hunters》的整体表现还不错。 目前还没有中文，不过对于一款只需要爽射的游戏来说，问题也不大。 [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

I bought it after EA release, it was good, somewhat unique and fun to play too. Now we got some updates and.. what should i say? The game is so bad now, i added it to my collection of "hated games". Why you ask? First of all, the first EA release was a linear shooter with multiple weapons, some perks and meta progression. Fine and good even tho a bit more on the grindy site. Now we have a totally different game, the original EA is now called "classic mode". The only shared thing we now have is multiple weapons. The game still does have perks and meta progression but the developers changed the whole aspect on how to play and how to progress more than 5 times already. I'm not talking about some slight changes or adding/removing some pits and pieces; no! They redone the meta progression more than 5 times, always different, always forcing us to grind the game even more and with every change resetting everything, except the last update as of writing that review. Also we now have multiple characters.. which plays totally the same.. and we have to level them. You guessed meta progression is global? Well it was, but now its to each character. And its so damn grindy. You get close to no points for successful runs and yet, the developers added ridiculously achievements to level up every character to level 125+. As I said, you gain close to nothing for each run so be sure to invest hundreds of hours just for those. Also we have now maps to freely move around in the "new" survivors mode instead of linear maps, while this sounds good, its actually not. The maps are bad, the design is terrible and they are not fun to play. The spawns are very badly placed, bosses can spawn at the other end of the map and hit you without you being able to get them first. The game is unforgiving and heck of grindy, yes i repeat myself. Also the developers likes to change achievements whenever they thing to do so. Meaning your 100% completion rate is never save. Good job guys... not! This is not the game i bought earlier anymore. Its something totally different. Its a grind simulator with no replay value whatsoever. The leaderboards are filled with cheaters every time. Doesn't make fun. Guess that's what I get for supporting an EA title. I wanted to wait for the full release but nope, it wont change my opinion. Bad game, stay away. Developers went to ignore list.

I'm going to be real honest here, i struggle to find enjoyment out of this game. The problem is several fold. - You got extremely poor awareness of enemies outside of your field of view. This is kinda lethal when you're playing a survivors game where getting hit, especially in long runs, is lethal. Sure, there's a minimap that shows enemies close to you but it's so damn tiny and also takes away your focus from looking at the game itself. *Update* Noticed a lot of people screaming 'skill issue' and throwing me clown awards for a legit problem, so let's clarify more. I've played and beaten many FPS games for over 30 years. I generally don't have this issue with games like Serious Sam, DOOM Eternal or several modern day boomer shooters generally played at a high difficulty level. The issue is that enemies are not responsive enough. There's not enough sound or animation. No footsteps for the vast majority of enemies, not enough attack sounds, not enough response of how hard you get hit. And again, in a game where the enemy count is often in the 100s with a rather poor minimap it is nearly impossible to not get hit. - The level design is kinda bad. It feels like the devs designed deathmatch stages and then built enemy spawners around it. They have places where you can exploit the AI's worst behaviours and simply live forever as long as you keep a eye out on certain enemies (looking at you, giant shield bros. You suck and take all the fun out of the game) - A enemy that blocks your shots in a survivors game is, in my honest opinion, a design mistake, especially in a game where the vast majority of your attacks are some form of projectile. They are anti-fun in a genre about power fantasy and doing extremely silly things with stacking buffs and attack layers. - The system that governs both auto-shots and different types of projectiles (*cough*flamethrower*cough*) is completely borked. It often doesn't shoot when you need it to or it just doesn't flat out work. It's bad and it forces players to actually shot manually. And it's extremely tiring on the hands as some weapons don't have automatic fire! - Weapons are kinda meh. They upgrade with interesting effects only for a short while, roughly 5-6 levels worth, before they simply default to simple stats. Sure you can spam a ton of them but they are kinda boring. Maybe if there was some weapon evolution system where a bunch of your guns can fuse into new, bigger ones or fuse into something else entirely (like a flamethrower made out of holy water, or blood, or acid, i mean come on!) that would be something and give far more drive to experiment with different builds. I feel like there is potential with a first person survivors game, but this doesn't feel like 1.0 to me. It felt like it needed something else to give it spice to counteract all the blandness or some of the bugs and design choices. Right now it's just not worth it. Maybe check back in the future.

未来可期，但目前的水准着实一般。 虽然貌似搞了吸血鬼幸存者这样的升级系统，但内核和KillingFloor，甚至CF/CSOL的挑战模式没有任何区别。打怪，拿到更好的武器，打更多的怪。问题是绝大多数武器都是传统FPS枪类武器，而吸血鬼幸存者中的合成超武，各种超强AOE，各种吸血/回复能力都基本没有继承，就导致这个游戏清屏十分困难，而狂暴刷新的怪让你也不能简单的像KillingFloor或是其他挑战模式一样绕圈子溜怪。而且我不知道为什么一个射击游戏要继承幸存者的捡经验球系统，冒着风险去怪群中捡经验球就会很容易损失宝贵的血量，不捡就是升级赶不上怪的强度，慢性死亡。 总之，FPS刷子游戏并不少，但是这款游戏只能说上不去下不来，卡在这了。

This game uses AI generated content without any disclosure on the store page. I'm pretty sure disclosure is currently required for your game to be sold on Steam. The game is great as a time waster, but nothing beyond that. It's mindless gameplay. There is very little strategy or playstyle diversity - nothing to actually sink your teeth into. If you pick the damage boosting constellations or grind a character for several runs, every run becomes piss-easy no matter what choices you make. If you lose a run, it's not because you played poorly or picked the wrong weapons/upgrades, but because you literally couldn't win without grinding upgrades. It doesn't feel like a roguelite, it feels a clicker game. To give you an idea of how much grinding the game expects, I literally did all content the game had to offer - I got every non-grinding achievement - before I was even halfway done grinding for level 150 on all characters. Same thing for classic mode; I did everything else before I was halfway done hitting "100%" with every starting weapon. This game is also unpolished in a lot of ways. Several descriptions contain broken English, which can fortunately be understood after a few re-reads, but it's clear that QA was not on the dev's mind. Another example is that the classic mode constellations have broken tooltip descriptions on the level select screen. You also can't hover over weapon attributes in the upgrade menu because the upgrades take priority over the tooltips. Overall, this game isn't what it claims to be. This is coming from someone who wishlisted the game after playing the demo during nextfest. If you want a good survivors game, there are plenty of better options out there.

一个字，爽！比高潮还爽！ [quote=] [table] [tr] [th]欢迎关注我们 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44941219/]游思妄想鉴赏家[/url][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th]带你寻找更多优质游戏 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote] 该说不说制作组确实很有想法，类幸存者类型下市面上都在卷2d的情况下，制作人竟然把这个类型做成了fps。类幸存者的怪物数量，加上fps的刺激，玩起来的感觉就像是体验上了杜蕾斯超薄的广告词一样，舒服又刺激！首先来说画面，对于独立游戏来说，画面从来不是什么卖点，本作的画面有点糙，低分辨率的马赛克风格很容易就糊成了一坨，看那人物的脸还以为是什么20年前的古早游戏，有点难绷了属于是。但马赛克风格并不代表作者的敷衍，相反游戏的马赛克风格更像是作者故意这么做的，因为枪械的建模和动画的视觉效果明显能够感受出作者是用心做过调教的，比如枪械的一些开火细节以及枪身自带的粒子特效等，都做得还真像是那么回事。作为类幸存者游戏，让人射的爽才是核心卖点。不同于传统类型只能带6把武器的游戏比如吸血鬼幸存者和土豆兄弟（多面手另说），吸血鬼猎人的主角人人都是多面手，最多同时持有的14把枪，它的火力能有多猛大火就不用多说了，在build成型，局外成长也构筑得当的情况下，30分钟的关卡流程直接10分钟就胡了，剩下的时间，琢磨着怎么10秒内秒杀4各boss好了。当然有天胡的时候就会有点背的时候，当你在局外成长没有多少加成的时候，就算在局内拿到了天胡，那也会打的相当困难，不过没关系，多来几次把局外成长点起来就ok，毕竟肉鸽就是这么玩的嘛。作为一款小体量的独立游戏，尽管目前阶段还有些小问题需要解决，比如在关内无法得知人物技能和龟壳盾哥正面无敌的buff实在太强等暂时性的小问题，总之，还是非常值得推荐给大家来体验的！

I legitimately can't find anything to enjoy about this game. It's basically an FPS survivors type game, but the vast majority of what's fun about those isn't at all on display here. First off, the weapons feel terrible to shoot. They have no power to them, are mostly incredibly similar to one another, take forever to reload, and are just not fun to shoot. Enemies are incredibly slow and it never felt intuitive to dispatch them. The first-person nature also betrays the game, as you've constantly got enemies shuffling up behind you. How are you supposed to see them in first-person? Either constantly check the radar or get hit in the back. The way the level-up upgrades work is also pretty confusing to me. You get a new one and it can replace one you've already got. I never feel like I'm getting stronger as I level up, plus I always find myself dying in just a few minutes due to all of the above. I really wanted a first-person survivors-like, but this one not only doesn't scratch that itch, but I just can't see how any would think this is a good game. Maybe I just don't get it, but I'm trying and everything just makes it such an unfun, cheap slog.

[b] [h2]A Guide to Florida Residential Life[/h2] [/b] If you've ever wanted a crash course in florida residential life, just play Vampire Hunters. This chaotic bullet hell game is the most accurate simulation I've ever seen. You've got the humid struggle for survival, constantly dodging creatures that have no business existing. They're not monsters, they're your neighbors - the guy who insists on watering his driveway, the ghoul with a pet gator. Your only job is to survive their bizarre, unpredictable movements while grabbing the random junk they leave behind. It’s basically a hilarious, high-speed tuesday in florida, and the best part is the final boss is way less stressful than a homeowners association meeting. I dont even know whats happening half of the time, but I guess neither do floridians. But I do know that guns make pew pew. and a lot of guns make a lot of pew pew.

This is basically what would happen if someone made a Unreal Tournament Vampire Survivors Mutator for Unreal Tournament 1999. Fun game and its exactly what you would expect if those two games merged. Level design is clearly inspired by Unreal\Quake. You'll get the vibes of it while playing. The only bad thing is its on a Modern engine "Unity" and runs poorly with stutters on good hardware because of it and would of been better off on said Unreal engine 1.0 by far. Your best bet is to cap the fps to 60 and run Framegen via the DUCK-LSFG which will remove the annoying stutters you get at high real framerates. It does work under W11 and Linux Mint tho so there's that, I would not call the performance stellar tho for whats getting displayed on screen for either OS tho, infact I'd call its graphics performance downright disgraceful but whatever, that's how it is in the modern era of gaming. Get it if you like really like FPS + Vampire Survivors you won't be disappointed in that regard.

The idea of holding 14 weapons at once was just outrageous, and silly enough to entice me. While I do admittedly enjoy turning my brain off while playing this, I also definitely understand that it can feel a little boring at times, with limited movement options, and enemies not being very interesting or dynamic, and frankly, kind of stupid. Then again, I suppose a lot of Survivors games are like that, aren't they? It's not about outwitting your enemies, it's about mowing hundreds of them down like a genocidal maniac, and this absolutely does deliver that much. Get it on sale, I guess. Neutral recommendation leaning towards positive, because it isn't bad. It could also be more polished than it is, though, and that I think would elevate it much higher than where it is currently.
